## Summary — CASE-001

**Classification: missing_ledger_entry**

**What I found**
- The case is bank-only: BNK-0025, 2026-08-06, "ACH CREDIT ARNOLD LTD", ref INV-1063, **+USD 6,595.32**.
- A reference search on INV-1063 returns **1 bank line and 0 ledger entries**, and the case flags `reference_matched_elsewhere = false` — so the receipt wasn't booked under another reference either.
- DOC-032 (customer invoice INV-1063, Arnold Ltd, issued 2026-06-27, due 2026-07-27) shows **USD 6,595.32 due** — an exact amount match, and an early-August settlement fits a past-due Net 30 invoice.
- Invoice is USD-denominated (no FX), and there is no second row on either side (not a duplicate). The cash has already cleared within the statement period, so it is not a timing difference.

**Proposed fix (pending human approval — nothing has been posted)**
| Account | Debit | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 1000 Cash - Operating | 6,595.32 | |
| 1200 Accounts Receivable | | 6,595.32 |

This records the Arnold Ltd receipt and clears open invoice INV-1063. Proposal ID PROP-5ECCDA4B is awaiting accountant review.
